title: sideritis arborescens subsp. maireana
intro: Sideritis arborescens subsp. maireana, commonly known as Spanish ironwort, is a plant species in the mint family that is native to the Iberian Peninsula. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with reported health benefits including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant effects, which can aid in the treatment of various conditions such as digestive issues, respiratory problems, and wounds. The therapeutic actions of Spanish ironwort include its ability to soothe and calm the nervous system, reduce fever, and act as a natural antispasmodic and anti-inflammatory agent. The bioactive constituents of Sideritis arborescens subsp. maireana include phenolic acids, flavonoids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential therapeutic uses.
